Description:
As you venture forward, a scorching trail sears its mark upon the grass, leaving a path of charred vegetation in its wake. Your attention is drawn to a pair of piercing yellow eyes that meet yours, and in that instant, the enigmatic nature of the Dragon becomes clear. 
The Dragons, embodying the essence of their dragon lineage, come in a myriad of colors that mirror their affinity to elemental forces. From the fiery red scales symbolizing a connection to flames, to the electric hues representing a mastery over lightning, each Dragons bears a unique chromatic expression of their power. Some may display majestic wings, capable of carrying them through the skies with grace, while others brandish horns and tails that serve as physical manifestations of their Drakan heritage.
Speaking a language known as Drakan, a complex tongue of breaths and resonating shouts, the Dragons wield a formidable ability to harness the elemental forces within them. Through their breath, they can unleash torrents of flame, bolts of lightning, icy gusts, or other elemental manifestations, harnessing and mastering their power to devastating effect. Born from eggs rather than nurtured within mammals, the Dragonsworn possess a profound connection to the cycles of life and rebirth, their hatching representing the emergence of ancient wisdom and raw potential.
Language: You speak Common and a number of chosen languages equal to your Focus or Presence, whichever is higher, of which one must be Drakan. Drakan is the ancient language of dragons that relies on conveying powerful messages through short words, shouts and dragon breath.
Other: Dragonsworn have tails, though you can choose not to have one.

Combat Extras: -50% Damage Taken from your chosen element.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Effect:
When creating your Hero, choose any element from Acid, Cold, Fire, Shock, Pulse, Poison and Scourge.
You take -50% Damage from that Damage type.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Notes: The color of your skin and scales as a Dragon should reflect the element you chose (e.g. Cold might be associated with white or blue Dragonswarne).

Starting Abilities Description.Color and Element:
When you create your Hero, choose your Dragon's color/element combination.
There is a large variety of options for which Dragon features you want to have, from being a primordial Dragon to a small, familiar-like creature.

Ability Choices Description: As a Dragon, you can choose how your Dragon's Breath has evolved.

~Drake Breath~.Effect: Shoot a quick burst with your elemental breath at a Unit, dealing 1d12 Damage (of your Element Type).

~Dragon Breath~.Effect: Choose a 3x3 meter area. All Units there take 2d8 Damage (of your Element Type).
~Dragon Breath~.Notes: You can use this if you didn't use it last turn.

~Back Wings~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 6 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Back Wings~.Upgrade: You have membranous dragon-like wings growing from your back, which allow you to fly for short distances.

~Hulking Dracontaur~.Effect:
Your lower body is 4-legged, like a draconic-centaur, and your size is Long.
You have -2 Health Regen and -1 Instinct, but +1 Might and, while Unarmored, you have +1 Defense instead of +1 Movement Speed.
You are Long and occupy a 2x1 meter area.

Combat Extras: Wear belts as bracers and bracers as rings
~Primordial Dragon~.Effect:
You are Large and occupy a 2x2 meter area.
You have +1 Focus (up to +4) and +6 Max Health, but -1 Instinct and -1 Presence.
~Primordial Dragon~.Downside:
Body and legs armor must be fitted on you by paying 50% of its original cost.
You can wear belts as bracers, and bracers as rings.

~Wing Arms~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Wing Arms~.Upgrade: Your arms and hands become wings, and your hands are more akin to talons.

Combat Extras: When you gain Shielding, give it +1
~Horns~.Effect:
Whenever you gain Shielding, increase its value by 1.
You have +2 in Intimidation.
~Horns~.Downside: You can't wear helmets (hats might fit you, though).

~Feral Claws~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike - if you rolled minimum, apply a ~Combo~.
Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum, the target becomes Blinded.

~Sharpen With Magic~.Effect:
Permanently sharpen your claws with a ^magic weapon^ worth at least 25 XP.
Increase the Damage of Feral Claws by +1.
The magic weapon is then destroyed.

~Feral Claws~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Second Skin~.Effect:
Choose one more Element from Dragon Ancestry
You take -50% Damage from that Damage type.
